details.summary:
Kunti Betta Sunrise Trek – An Adventure Across Twin Hills

Located near Pandavapura in Mandya district, Kunti Betta is a striking pair of rocky hills that offers an exciting escape from Bengaluru. Its rugged terrain, open countryside and distinctive twin-hill landscape create a refreshing setting for travellers looking for an active weekend adventure.

The trail takes you across uneven and rocky sections as you gradually make your way towards the higher parts of the hill. The changing terrain keeps the climb engaging, while the surrounding countryside opens up along the route and adds to the experience.

The highlight comes in the early morning when you reach the summit and watch the sunrise spread across the surrounding landscape. The rocky top provides a memorable place to pause, enjoy the views and capture photographs.

With approximately 6 km of trekking and a moderate level of difficulty, Kunti Betta offers a more adventurous sunrise experience while remaining suitable for travellers with a reasonable level of fitness. Its combination of rugged trails, twin rocky hills and wide countryside views gives the trek a character of its own.

Whether you're planning an active weekend with friends or simply want to trade the city for a morning in the hills, Kunti Betta brings together adventure, scenery and a rewarding summit experience.

itinerary.title: Bengaluru to Kunti Betta
itinerary.description: Your Kunti Betta adventure begins late at night as you leave Bengaluru and travel towards Pandavapura.

activities.title: Board Vehicle
activities.description: Meet your trip coordinator at the designated pickup point and board the vehicle for your journey towards Kunti Betta. Sit back, relax and get comfortable for the overnight journey.

activities.title: Early Morning | Arrive at Kunti Betta Base
activities.description: Reach the designated base/parking area and prepare for the trek. After a short briefing from your trek leader, get your headlamp or torch ready and prepare to begin the climb.

activities.title: Early Morning | Begin the Trek
activities.description: Start your ascent towards the Kunti Betta summit in the early morning darkness. The trail takes you across uneven and rocky sections as you gradually gain elevation.

activities.title: Before Sunrise | Approach the Summit
activities.description: As the sky begins to brighten, continue towards the summit while the surrounding landscape slowly comes into view.

activities.title: Sunrise | Reach the Summit
activities.description: Reach the summit in time for sunrise and enjoy the changing colours across the surrounding countryside. Take photographs, explore the rocky summit and spend some time taking in the panoramic views.

activities.title: Morning | Explore the Summit
activities.description: Spend some time exploring the twin-hill landscape and enjoying the open views from the top before beginning the descent.

activities.title: Begin the Descent
activities.description: Start your descent with the trek leader. With daylight now covering the trail, experience the rocky route from a different perspective.

activities.title: Trek Ends
activities.description: Reach the base after completing the trek and take some time to rest and freshen up.

activities.title: Breakfast Stop
activities.description: Stop at a local restaurant or en-route eatery for breakfast. Breakfast is self-sponsored.

activities.title: Return to Bengaluru
activities.description: Board the vehicle and begin your journey back to Bengaluru.

activities.title: Bengaluru Drop
activities.description: Arrive back in Bengaluru and conclude your Kunti Betta Sunrise Trek experience.

sections.title: A Trek Across Twin Rocky Hills
sections.body:
Kunti Betta is known for its distinctive pair of rocky hills, giving the trek a landscape that feels different from many of the sunrise trails around Bengaluru. The route moves through rugged rock formations and open sections, creating an engaging climb from the base towards the summit.

As you gain height, the surrounding countryside becomes increasingly visible, with broad views opening up from the hilltop. The combination of rocky terrain and expansive scenery makes Kunti Betta a memorable destination for trekkers looking for a more adventurous morning outdoors.

sections.title: Things to carry
sections.body:
Things to Carry for Kunti Betta Trek

(Since the trek begins during the early hours, packing the right essentials is important.)

[Must Carry]
• Small trekking backpack
• At least 2 litres of drinking water
• Headlamp or torch
• Trekking shoes with good grip
• Light jacket or windcheater
• Extra pair of socks
• Cap
• Sunglasses
• Sunscreen
• Energy bars or dry fruits
• Personal medication

• Fully charged mobile phone
• Power bank
• Valid government-issued ID

[During Monsoon]
• Rain jacket or poncho
• Waterproof backpack cover
• Waterproof phone pouch
• Extra clothes and socks

Packing Tip

Keep your backpack light. Avoid carrying unnecessary items as you'll be walking for several hours over uneven terrain.

sections.title: Trail guidelines
sections.body:
Kunti Betta is a natural destination with rugged terrain. Help preserve the hills for future travellers.

"Trek Responsibly. Respect the Hills."

• Follow your trek leader's instructions at all times.
• Follow local rules and restrictions where applicable.
• Stay with the group throughout the trek.
• Remain on the designated trekking trail.
• Do not litter.
• Carry all waste back with you.
• Avoid single-use plastic.
• Do not smoke or consume alcohol during the trek.
• Do not light fires or campfires.
• Do not disturb wildlife.
• Do not damage plants or natural formations.
• Be careful around steep and rocky sections.
• Avoid standing too close to edges while taking photographs.
• Wear appropriate trekking footwear.
• Stay hydrated throughout the trek.
• Take breaks whenever required.
• Avoid loud music that may disturb wildlife and fellow trekkers.

"Leave Only Footprints. Take Only Memories."
